headline: European Natural Gas Prices Surge 8.6% on Cold Snap Forecasts
summary: European benchmark TTF natural gas prices surged 8.6% to 96.08 euros per MWh as forecasts of an upcoming cold snap raised concerns over low winter inventories.
why: Dutch Title Transfer Facility (TTF) futures serve as the primary pricing benchmark for natural gas in Europe.

impacts.name: Dutch TTF Natural Gas
impacts.why: Forecasts of colder weather increased expected heating demand against depleted storage levels, driving TTF gas prices up.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: European gas prices rose significantly as weather forecasts signaled colder temperatures, feeding market concerns over depleted winter gas inventories.
